Prophet (SAW) was wearing a white kurta and jacket on top, the tall man was wearing something white.. Prophet (SAW) was speaking to either me or the tall man, couldnt distinguish.. Question: Assalamu Alaykum Please interpret this dream of mine Insha Allah As i was saying, when i was a litle girl, i dreamed that Prophet Muhammad (SAW) and a tall man were standing by my bed. Prophet (SAW) was wearing a white kurta and jacket on top, the tall man was wearing something white.. Prophet (SAW) was speaking to either me or the tall man, couldnt distinguish.. Then Prophet (SAW) took my right hand and held it for like 1 minute. Then i woke up What does this dream mean please.. Jazaak Allah Answer ID: 19832 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 293/241=1431) You should pay attention to follow the Shariah and adhere by the way of the Prophet صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم , divine help will come to your rescue, it is a blessed dream. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
